items.heading: Nigerian Jollof Rice
details: Key ingredients: rice, tomato, pepper, onion, spices
Blend tomato, red pepper and onion into a smooth base.
Fry the base until it darkens and the oil rises to the top.
Add rice and stock, stirring well to coat.
Cover and cook on low heat until the rice is tender and smoky at the base.

items.heading: Egusi Soup
details: Key ingredients: ground melon seeds, leafy greens, palm oil, meat
Fry ground egusi (melon seeds) in palm oil until it clumps lightly.
Add meat, fish and stock, simmering until tender.
Stir in chopped leafy greens.
Cook until thick and serve with pounded yam or fufu.

items.heading: Jollof Rice
details: Ingredients: rice, vegetables or protein, onion/garlic, oil, seasoning and water/stock.
Cook the rice by absorption or steaming.
Sauté the other ingredients separately, combine and season to taste.
